title: mut.channel_chiharu_shiota
mutation_directive: Channel Chiharu Shiota's thread-installation aesthetic. Render with LINES instead of points: replace THREE.Points with THREE.LineSegments (or many THREE.Line objects); each segment connects two anchor positions in space. Mass count: 8000-20000 segments. Each line is a single straight thread — no curves. Anchor strategy: pick lines connect each particle to its 3 nearest neighbors — creates a triangulated mesh feel, like tensile fabric. Palette: Shiota's signature is dense red (crimson #9c1f1f), or pure white on black, or pure black on white — pick ONE color, stay near monochrome. Use LineBasicMaterial with low opacity (0.06-0.12) and additive blending so the network reads as gauzy volume. The whole field should feel like emotional infrastructure — threads as memory, connection, tension, distance. Suspend in architectural-feeling space (extra negative space at top, threads pooling at bottom). Subtle sway under pointer/audio is OK; the threads should remain readable as discrete strands.
